claims.text: 785 companies are classified in the fourteen counties.
claims.source: GAC-PIC vault company notes, extracted 2026-08-14; footprint NEO-14 (vault-tagged)
claims.falsified_if: The vault extract is re-run and companies are added, reclassified, or the in_neo14 flag changes. NOTE: this page uses NEO-14, not PIC-12 — the two share only 10 counties and will not reconcile with cluster-health.

claims.text: 174 of those companies carry no value-chain role and appear at no stage.
claims.falsified_if: Classification work fills gaps. This number falling is progress, and every 'thin stage' claim on the page gets weaker as it does.

claims.text: Census counts 653 polymer and chemical establishments across the same counties.
claims.falsified_if: A CBP vintage change. NOTE: CBP counts ESTABLISHMENTS (plants) and the vault counts COMPANIES — these never reconcile and are never divided except as a labeled coverage indicator.

claims.text: Three counties have no classified companies at all.
claims.source: GAC-PIC vault against Census CBP, by county
claims.assert: len([c for c in D['chain']['counties'] if c['classified'] == 0]) == 3
claims.actual: [c['county'] for c in D['chain']['counties'] if c['classified'] == 0]
claims.falsified_if: Any company is classified in Huron, Richland or Crawford. This is a prospecting list, not a claim about the region.

claims.text: The region is thinnest where the applications are thickest — 12 companies against 26 applications at feedstock, 246 against 20 at conversion.
claims.source: GAC-PIC vault value_chain against the 2026 intake export value-chain position
claims.assert: one(s for s in D['viz']['spine'] if s['key']=='feedstock')['supply'] == 12 and one(s for s in D['viz']['spine'] if s['key']=='feedstock')['demand'] == 26 and one(s for s in D['viz']['spine'] if s['key']=='converters')['supply'] == 246
claims.actual: [(s['key'], s['supply'], s['demand']) for s in D['viz']['spine']]
claims.falsified_if: Either side is re-extracted. The two sides are DIFFERENT UNITS — companies and applications — on separate scales meeting at a center line, never one axis and never a ratio bar.
